submitted_defect.actual: The modal allows free scrolling of the entire container. As a result, the "Add User" and "Cancel" buttons scroll out of view along with the input fields, requiring the user to scroll back up or to the very bottom to interact with the action buttons.
submitted_defect.expected: The modal should have a fixed height or a scrollable container for the input fields. The "Add User" and "Cancel" buttons should remain pinned/sticky at the bottom of the modal at all times, ensuring they are always accessible to the user without needing to scroll to the very end of the content.
submitted_defect.scenario: Verification of the "Add Admin Account" modal UI behavior and layout consistency during scrolling.
submitted_defect.steps:
1. Navigate to the "User Management" (إدارة المستخدمين) section.
2. Click on the button to add a new admin account to trigger the modal.
3. Fill in all required fields (First Name, Last Name, Username, Email, Mobile Number).
4. Scroll down within the modal content.
5. Observe the behavior of the "Add User" and "Cancel" buttons at the bottom of the modal.
submitted_defect.title: LightMode_SIT_Android_Add user modal buttons not anchored correctly

test_cases.summary: when scrolling to the end of the page, the buttons arent sticking to the buttom, should limit the scrolling, not free scrolling

submitted_defect.actual: The text within the "Login History" list items is incorrectly formatted and misaligned. The date and time strings are duplicated and wrapped improperly, causing the text to appear "flipped" or jumbled. Additionally, the UI elements (IP address and device type) are not aligned according to the design, resulting in a broken layout.
submitted_defect.expected: The "Login History" screen should display data in a clean, structured format as per the design specifications. The date and time should be clearly separated, and the device type and IP address should be aligned correctly in their respective positions without overlapping or redundant text.
submitted_defect.scenario: Verification of the "Login History" screen UI layout and text alignment.
submitted_defect.steps:
1. Launch the application and log in with a valid account.
2. Navigate to the user profile
3. Select the "Login History" option to view the list of login sessions.
4. Observe the formatting and alignment of the date, time, device type, and IP address information within the list items.
submitted_defect.title: LightMode_SIT_Android_Login history text alignment and layout issues

test_cases.summary: the text is flipped, not aligned correctly

submitted_defect.scenario: Verification of the "Products and Services" overflow menu (three-dot icon) styling and typography consistency on the mobile application.
submitted_defect.steps:
1. Launch the mobile application and log in.
2. Navigate to the "Products and Services" (المنتجات والخدمات) tab.
3. Locate the overflow menu icon (three dots) positioned at the top left of the screen.
4. Tap on the overflow menu icon to trigger the dropdown list.
5. Observe the text styling and font applied to the menu items ("Short Codes" and "Terms and Conditions").
submitted_defect.expected: The dropdown menu items should strictly adhere to the design system specifications, utilizing the approved font family, weight, and size as defined in the Figma design files to ensure visual consistency across the application.
submitted_defect.actual: The text within the dropdown menu does not match the approved font style/typography defined in the design requirements. The font appears inconsistent with the rest of the application's UI components.

submitted_defect.expected: The OTP verification page should maintain consistent typography and font family styling as defined in the brand’s style guide and as observed in the preceding steps of the suspension journey.
submitted_defect.scenario: Verify UI consistency, specifically font family adherence, throughout the end-to-end SIM suspension journey for a GSM Voice/Data package.
submitted_defect.steps:
1. Navigate to Products and Services > Mobility Services and select an eligible Postpaid/Control Plus mobile number.
2. Select the "Suspend" option from the Manage Line section and confirm the prompt.
3. Select a suspension duration (1-12 months) and accept the terms and conditions after reviewing the displayed suspension fees.
4. Proceed to the OTP verification screen.
5. Observe the font family used for the text elements on the OTP verification page.

test_guide.look_for:
• Consistent font, typography, and UI element styling throughout the entire suspension flow.
• Correct display of monthly suspension fees and accurate duration selection options.
• Mandatory OTP verification requirement before final submission.
• Correct generation of the success message and unique order number.
• System-wide visual adherence to the brand's style guide and accessibility standards.
test_guide.steps:
1. Navigate to Products and Services > Mobility Services and select an eligible Postpaid/Control Plus mobile number.
2. Select the "Suspend" option from the Manage Line section and confirm the prompt.
3. Select a suspension duration (1-12 months) and accept the terms and conditions after reviewing the displayed suspension fees.
4. Complete the OTP verification process to authenticate the request.
5. Submit the suspension request and verify the success message and order number.
6. Observe the UI layout, font, and style consistency across all screens of the suspension journey.
test_guide.what_to_test: Verify the end-to-end SIM suspension flow for a valid GSM voice/data package, ensuring accurate data processing and UI consistency across the entire journey.

* Proper font rendering and alignment of all labels and buttons throughout the suspension flow.
* Correct display of suspension fees (in SAR) and mandatory Terms & Conditions.
* Clear and accurate error messages (e.g., system failure or invalid OTP) as per the requirements.
* Successful backend audit logging of the User ID, action, timestamp, and verification status.
* Presence of the order number upon successful submission.
* Correct disabling of post-management features (e.g., credit limit change) post-suspension.

Introduce an invalid input (e.g., interrupt network or provide wrong OTP) to trigger potential error messages. 5. Complete the flow with valid details and verify the OTP verification step. 6. test_guide.look_for:

• Correct alignment of error banners or text relative to the input fields.

submitted_defect.title: MS1MS2_Prod_Sanity_IOS_Password reset returns invalid JWT error 401
submitted_defect.scenario: Verification of the "Reset Password" functionality for an AP user, ensuring correct system behavior, UI consistency in Light Mode, and adherence to specified Font Family requirements.
submitted_defect.steps:
1. Navigate to the application login page.
2. Click on the "Forgot Password" or "Reset Password" link.
3. Enter a valid username associated with an AP user account.
4. Click the "Submit" or "Reset" button.
5. Observe the system response and the UI presentation.
submitted_defect.expected: The system should process the request and display a success message (e.g., "Password reset link sent to your email") or a standard validation message. The UI should maintain the Light Mode theme and display all text using the designated project Font Family.
submitted_defect.actual: The system fails to process the request and returns a technical error message: {"ErrorCode":401, "ErrorMessage":"Jwt Invalid, Please Generate new Jwt!"}. The expected success flow is interrupted by this authentication/token error.
